segments.footer: Independent evaluation. Approvals in this run were given by a script, not by a person.
segments.say: This is an independent check of the OpenCode V2 adapter for the Elephant Goldfish Model, at candidate c72e2ef, using a real model. | You are watching one brainstorm run on fake data.
The operator asks for a brainstorm about a made-up tool library. | The orchestrator reads the guide and the skill, and asks its questions before any review.
After the answers, it writes down a working hypothesis.
It stops at the readiness gate. Nothing goes to the model while the question waits.
Once approved, seven reviewers start. Each gets a fresh session, with read and glob only.
The guard keeps reviewers away from the project's AGENTS.md, so its instructions cannot steer them. In this run, no reviewer opened it. | One reviewer tried the fake .env file, and was denied.
The orchestrator then writes the concepts brief itself.
A second gate asks what happens next, and the brainstorm ends.
